content.title: Use Cmd/Ctrl + K to focus the global search field
content.test_md_blob:
# Use Cmd/Ctrl + K to focus the global search field

> Prove the documented keyboard shortcut moves focus to the global search field and exposes a visible focus indicator without requiring pointer interaction.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Store whether the global search field is focused as shortcut_focus_baseline before invoking the keyboard shortcut.

## Step 3

With browser focus outside the global search field, invoke Cmd + K on macOS or Ctrl + K on non-macOS to trigger the documented global-search shortcut.

## Step 4

Assert the global search field is now focused and a visible focus ring is shown around it.

## Step 5

Assert the focused global search field still measures 420px wide and 36px high.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-160, ac-161, ac-162, ac-163

Confirm state-transition check: focused (equals) — the stated promise: Pressing Cmd/Ctrl + K focuses the global search field.

content.title: Press Escape to dismiss focused global search when no overlay is active

check.baseline: global search field focused and no search overlay active

content.test_md_blob:
# Press Escape to dismiss focused global search when no overlay is active

> Prove Escape clears the active global search focus state when the field is focused and no search overlay is open, following the recommended branch of the unresolved Escape rule.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Focus the global search field from the header without entering text, and confirm no search overlay is visible before dismissal is attempted.

## Step 3

Store the focused field state with no visible search overlay as escape_focus_baseline before pressing Escape.

## Step 4

Press Escape once while the global search field is focused and no search overlay is visible.

## Step 5

Assert the global search field is no longer focused and no search overlay is shown after the keypress.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-165

Confirm state-transition check: global search field not focused (equals) — the stated promise: When the global search field is focused and no search overlay is active, pressing Escape clears focus from the field.

content.title: Inspect placeholder text and stable dimensions on direct focus
content.test_md_blob:
# Inspect placeholder text and stable dimensions on direct focus

> Prove the centered header search field shows the promised placeholder, gains the promised focus affordances, and keeps its 420px by 36px footprint when focused.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Inspect the global search field in the header and assert its placeholder text is exactly "Search assets, metrics, reports..."; store its visible width as prefocus_width and height as prefocus_height.

## Step 3

Focus the global search field directly from the header.

## Step 4

Assert a visible focus ring is shown around the focused global search field.

## Step 5

Assert the focused global search field measures 420px wide and 36px high, and confirm those dimensions match prefocus_width and prefocus_height.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-164, ac-161, ac-162, ac-163

Confirm absolute check: Search assets, metrics, reports... (equals) — the stated promise: The global search field placeholder is "Search assets, metrics, reports...".

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Highest value because the PRD explicitly promises keyboard access via Cmd/Ctrl + K and the path also covers focus-ring visibility and stable focused dimensions in one run.
[value_score] High value because it proves the user-facing placeholder copy and direct-focus styling stability on the primary visible control in the header.
[value_score] Useful edge coverage because Escape dismissal is explicitly promised, but this branch is narrower and partially assumption-bound by the unresolved overlay activation rule.

[self_critique] The primary oracle proves the shortcut-driven focus transition directly via ac-160. I kept dimension and focus-ring assertions in the same path because they are observable in the post-focus state, but I did not over-claim the unresolved information-blue border token from gap-27.

[self_critique] The baseline step precedes Escape, so the state-transition check proves dismissal rather than a pre-existing unfocused state. I limited the scenario to the no-overlay branch to avoid inventing how the overlay becomes active.

[self_critique] The primary oracle proves the exact placeholder copy from ac-164, while the remaining assertions stay limited to visible focus indication and unchanged documented dimensions. I avoided broad claims about search results or overlay behavior because the sources do not specify them.
